title: Attention Is All You Need
core_breakthrough: Scaled Dot-Product & Multi-Head Self-Attention eliminating recurrence and convolutions entirely.

sublayers.name: Token Embedding
sublayers.explanation: Converts discrete tokens into continuous vector representations.

sublayers.name: Positional Encoding
sublayers.explanation: Injects relative/absolute position info since the model has no recurrence.

sublayers.name: Multi-Head Attention
sublayers.explanation: Allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces.

sublayers.name: Position-Wise FFN
sublayers.explanation: Applied to each position separately and identically.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling
core_breakthrough: Selective state space mechanism (S6) with hardware-aware parallel scan.

sublayers.name: Selection Mechanism
sublayers.explanation: Makes the SSM parameters input-dependent, allowing the model to filter/remember info.

sublayers.name: Parallel Scan
sublayers.explanation: Hardware-aware associative scan for linear-time recurrent computation.

cons.claim: Hardware-specific implementation (SRAM fusion) required for speed

title: Mixture-of-Depths
core_breakthrough: Dynamic per-token compute routing with top-k capacity budget.

sublayers.name: Router Scoring
sublayers.explanation: Assigns a score to each token to determine if it should be processed.

sublayers.name: Capacity Filtering
sublayers.explanation: Only the top-k tokens are processed, others skip via residual.

title: A Comprehensive Survey of MoE
core_breakthrough: Taxonomy of sparse gating and expert architectures.

sublayers.name: Sparse Gating
sublayers.explanation: Activates only a subset of experts per token.

pros.claim: High parameter count with low active compute

cons.claim: High memory overhead for expert storage

title: Sliding Window Attention Training (SWAT)
core_breakthrough: Sigmoid attention + balanced ALiBi/RoPE for long-context.

sublayers.name: Activation
sublayers.explanation: Eliminates softmax normalization sinks for better stability.

pros.claim: Stable training for extreme context lengths

cons.claim: Departure from standard softmax KV management

title: Titans: Learning to Memorize
core_breakthrough: Test-time gradient descent on associative neural memory.

sublayers.name: Surprise Gradient
sublayers.explanation: Updates memory based on how 'surprising' the input is.

title: TransMamba: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba
core_breakthrough: Sequence-level switching with shared projection matrices.

sublayers.name: Unified Matrix
sublayers.explanation: Zero overhead parameter sharing between attn and SSM.

pros.claim: Best of both worlds: recall + linear throughput

cons.claim: Complexity in routing at sequence level
